name: SECOND BRAIN
_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. config.json stays on your machine — it is never served to the browser and is excluded from the shareable zip. Do NOT paste these keys into chat.

model._comment: The 'brain' that answers from your notes. EITHER native Claude (provider 'anthropic', model 'claude-opus-4-8', leave base_url empty) OR any OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as GLM 5.2 via OpenRouter/Z.ai (set base_url to the provider's /v1 URL and model to its slug). Get the exact base_url + slug from your provider's docs.

elevenlabs._comment: OPTIONAL premium voice. LEAVE THESE EMPTY and Jarvis speaks in your browser's own built-in voice — free, no key, works out of the box. To upgrade to the cinematic 'Jarvis' voice, paste your OWN ElevenLabs api_key (secret) + a voice_id. The voice_id is safe to share; the api_key is not.

agent._comment: Structural safety for /agent DRAFT mode — tools the agent may NOT use until you confirm an action. Wildcards match MCP tool names. These defaults let a draft read/research but never send, post, delete, spend, write, shell, or delegate. Override only if you know what you're doing.

telephony._comment: Retell AI (retellai.com): buy a number, create agents from retell-agent-prompts.md, paste ids. 'from'=your Retell number, 'callback'=YOUR cell (E.164). 'pin'=hotline code for calling from other phones.

models._comment: OPTIONAL — extra named brains for the 'Jarvis, try on <name>' hot-swap. Built-in spoken names already work: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable (Claude Fable 5.1), and 'back to default'. Entries here inherit the top-level model block; entries with a base_url and an empty api_key automatically use the openrouter key below. Each named brain gets its own curated swap line. Swaps are runtime-only and reset on restart.

openrouter._comment: OPTIONAL but the magic trick — ONE key, EVERY model. With this set, 'Jarvis, try on grok / gpt / gemini / deepseek / llama / kimi…' fuzzy-matches the LIVE OpenRouter catalogue (newest match wins) and swaps brains on the spot. Get a key at openrouter.ai/keys.

openai._comment: OPTIONAL — GPT Realtime as a second live-voice engine for the 📡 button (true speech-to-speech, sub-second). GPT is only ears+mouth: the ask_jarvis tool routes every knowledge question back to this server, so Claude + your vault stay the brain. Voice-pick the engine: 'use the realtime engine' / 'use the elevenlabs engine' / 'auto'.

hardware._comment: OPTIONAL — for 'Jarvis, connect my AirPods' (needs `brew install blueutil` + your AirPods' Bluetooth address from System Settings → Bluetooth → ⓘ).

hue._comment: OPTIONAL — the room becomes Jarvis's body: lights pulse emerald while he speaks, flash red on errors, dim in focus mode. Leave empty and it's a silent no-op. To pair: run the server, then say 'set up the lights' (press the round button on the Hue bridge first) — it auto-fills bridge_ip/app_key into jarvis-hue.json. Or set them here by hand.

_duplex_comment: LIVE full-duplex voice (the 📡 button) uses ElevenLabs Agents with THIS server as the custom LLM, so the brain stays Claude + your vault. It needs (1) an ElevenLabs api_key WITH Agents/Conversational-AI scope (above), and (2) a public https tunnel to port 4722. See integrations/TAILSCALE.md, then run: python3 setup_duplex.py --url <public-url>. State lands in jarvis-duplex.json (gitignored).

business.name: Your Company LLC
business.blurb: one line about what you sell — grounds invoices and quotes

typesafe._comment: Optional. Jev by TypeSafe AI gives Jarvis 200 ms reflexes: lane routing, the vault verdict, the judge, inbox triage, filming mode. Free key with $5 credit at typesafe.ai (no waitlist). Leave the placeholder to run without it.

rea._comment: V7.2 X-RAY VISION (REA, Reverse Engineer Anything). Run `python3 setup_rea.py` once: it installs REA pinned to the tested version into ~/.jarvis-tools/rea (needs Node.js 22.19+ and Google Chrome). Optional overrides: home (where REA lives), node (path to node), chrome (path to Chrome), headless (true = site teardowns run in a hidden browser), app_shot (false = never open an app to snapshot it).

missions._comment: V7.2 BUILDER + REA analyst. rea_live=true lets the REA worker also RUN or drive the thing it analyzes (LLDB launches, native/Electron/browser scenarios, Android device installs). Default off: static analysis only, nothing launches during a demo.
